Email: dsvellal@gmail.com | LinkedIn | +91 9972312693 | Bangalore, Karnataka
B.E. CSE, RV College of Engineering, Bangalore, VTU [2003-2007] - 79.2% Aggr
MSc Yoga, Annamalai University [2010-2011]
DoB: 6th Dec 1985 | Proficient in English, Kannada, Hindi

Over 13 years of experience in design, architecture, orchestration & implementation of a number of successful scalable projects from the ground up in industries like eCommerce, Healthcare, Insurance, Natural resources. Brings expertise to solve technologically complex problems & build useful software, platforms and tools. An analytical thinker with a proven track record to consistently resolve key customer pain points & providing world-class customer/user experience, often called upon to consult on problems that have eluded resolution by others. A results driven execution specialist, who is proactive in driving functional and nonfunctional requirement implementations, performance improvements, handling uncertainties & mitigating risks. A hard-working team player who does whatever-it-takes to deliver results; no excuses.

=== AREA OF EXPERTISE ===
Java & J2EE, Data Structure & Algorithm, Product Design, Development, Verification & Delivery, Team building & Leadership, Risk management & mitigation, Release management, Source control management, Agile development & continuous integration, Proactive Communication (Written & Verbal)

=== PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE ===
- Feb 2016 – Till Date: 2 years 5 months, Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Development Center India Pvt Ltd
- April 2013 – Nov 2015: 2 years 8 months, Senior Lead – Software Development, Exeter Software India Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore
- July 2007 – Mar 2013: 5 years 9 months, Staff Software Engineer, IBM – India Software Labs, Bangalore

=== KEY ENGINEERING HIGHLIGHTS ===
- Designed & productionised (D&P) config & rules driven API to evaluate purchases on amazon.in & add friction to purchases with abusive intent
- D&P a generic context container for multiple fraud-check-services, removing SDE effort, enhancing platform to evaluate any transaction
- D&P a microservice from scratch to orchestrate uniqueness-of-account-check for AmazonPay, supporting 1130 TPS in production
- D&P a query generation & ingestion tool, that has ingested more than 2 Billion ASIN data by createDate & category, into our analytics system
- Improved reporting tool by optimising finding data-mismatches, saving SDE and ML Scientists time by over 60%
- Benchmarked services via performance tools & fine-tuned code & hardware to achieve $34000 cost reduction & 20% TPS improvement
- Winner of Amazon's ASCS Hackathon 2016: 45 working prototypes, 30+ teams, 4 countries, judged by principal engineers & senior managers
- Innovation driven thought process leading to 2 USPTO filed patents, 1 publication with ip.com & 3 developerworks articles
- Youngest member of the Prototyping & Architecture group hand picked by the CEO of Exeter, responsible for feature implementation decisions
- Youngest member of the Technical Experts Council – India at IBM

=== KEY LEADERSHIP HIGHLIGHTS ===
- Proactive in mitigating risk and setting up projects for success, multiple times, recognized via TRMS ZEUS Award in Oct 2017
- Instrumental in identifying and customising processes, adopted across different teams in Amazon, recognized via TRMS SPOT Award in Nov 2017
- Facilitator for Scrum & Agile Product Ownership Workshops, with 5 day-long sessions, 150+ participants, avg. presenter rating at 4.27 out of 5
- Creator and owner of multiple referred assets: Onboarding Guide, OnCall Guide, Troubleshooting page, Coding standards, Bookmarks etc.
- Tech-promotion calibrater at Amazon, having calibrated 3 promotions from SDE-1 to SDE-2, all of them led to positive conversions
- Passionate about interviews, have created an interview guideline document & calibrated questions for my org. 71 interviews, conversion rate of 30%
- Organizing org level hack-days multiple times across all companies worked for
- Mentoring & leading a team of 15+ members & was directly accountable & responsible for the delivery of product functionality
- Providing regular performance reviews via written communication & one-one meetings, & being responsible for the career growth of team members

=== SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER II, AMAZON DEVELOPMENT CENTER INDIA PVT. LTD. (FEB 2016 – PRESENT) ===
Accountable & responsible for building microservices, APIs, tools and platforms at the Amazon Retail Catalog Services and the Transaction Risk Management Systems organisations. Day-to-day responsibilities: disambiguating problems by defining structured use-cases, design for scale, performance and reusability (HLD & LLD), code, write test-cases (unit & integration), deploy, maintain code, mentor juniors, imbibe best practices.

Key contributions:
- Implemented rules & config driven API to add friction to a purchase with inventory-block-abuse pattern
- Designed generic context container for fraud-check-services, now used by 9 external clients to onboard to fraud-check platform
- Implemented a micro service to check for uniqueness in account creation for AmazonPay, supporting 1130 TPS in production
- Modified an open-source JSON parser (JsonLib) to handle inconsistent xml to json parsing & improved catalog indexing by 20%
- Optimised software by running performance benchmarking tools & identified hardware glitches, saved $34000 in 2017
- Facilitated 5+ day-long workshops on Scrum & Agile Product Ownership, 150+ participants, avg. presenter rating of 4.27 out of 5
- Customised the scrum process for my team & bringing our task completion rate to 85% from 63%
- Authored & owned multiple processes including Onboarding, on-call guide, troubleshooting pages, bookmarks
- Wrote a reporting tool to optimise comparisons & reduce SDE & ML scientists effort by 60%
- Tool to automate the manual opening of SLA missed workflows for manual investigation
- Tool to automatically ingest ASIN data daily (over 2 Billion), by createDate and category into analytics systems

=== SENIOR LEAD – SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT, EXETER SOFTWARE INDIA PVT. LTD. (APRIL 2013 – NOV 2015) ===
Accountable for critical functions of the Patient Protection & Affordable Care Act implementation for Hawaii & Vermont.
Technical contributions:
- 60% technical & functional ownership of product features
- 3x faster page loads by adopting a memoized data-fetch model
- 90% reduction in dependency errors via common dependency library
- 2x faster implementation via re-architecting & creating central modules
- 3rd party API integration leading to successful business opportunities
- Encryption layer in Java for reduced security risks
- Reusable code-base via centralized business layer
- Successfully leading & resolving 15+ customer critical situations in 20 months

Leadership contributions:
- SPOC for functionalities between Legal, Functional, Dev & QA teams
- 5+ release scoping, execution, artefact & configuration management
- Devising a Dev to QA to Deployment hand-off process
- Regular performance reviews, mentoring & career planning for 15+ members
- Managed a 20+ team, including performance appraisals, career growth

=== STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, IBM – ISL, BANGALORE (JULY 2007 – MARCH 2013) ===
Technical contributions:
- Enabling JAXWS on IBM's LWI framework via SOAP 1.2; TDD for Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer
- Achieving virtual-zero defects for Expeditor toolkit releases
- Developing data-transformation layer for NRCOE solutions

- Regular Scrum Master
